intro: Welcome to MyYatra, your travel story across Nepal. Here's how to use the app, in twelve quick steps.
outro: That's MyYatra. Mark your first district, and start your yatra.

steps.01_welcome: Open the app and tap Get started.
steps.02_signup: Add your name, email and a password, accept the privacy policy, and create your account.
steps.03_interests: Next, tell MyYatra what you love. Choose as many kinds of places as you like. This starts your Journey DNA.
steps.04_style: Then answer a few questions about how often you travel, your style, and who you go with.
steps.05_plan: Set your usual budget, how far you're happy to go, and your favourite season.
steps.06_visited: Finally, tick any districts you've already visited, and tap Finish setup.
steps.07_home: Your home screen shows your footprint across Nepal, your Journey DNA, and fresh picks every week.
steps.08_explore: In Explore, search all seventy-seven districts, or filter them by province.
steps.09_district: Tap a district to see the best season, the cost, how to get there, and local festivals and food.
steps.10_mark: Been there? Tap Mark visited, and choose the date of your trip.
steps.11_places: Add the places you went, and tag what you did at each one.
steps.12_visited_card: Your visit now shows on the district page, ready to edit any time.
steps.13_safety: Every district has safety notes, emergency numbers, and a quick check-in to say you're safe.
steps.14_review: Share your experience with a star rating and a short review.
steps.15_review_done: Your review is published for other travellers to read.
steps.16_offline: And save the district for offline, so it's there even without signal.
steps.17_itinerary: Planning a trip? Create an itinerary with dates, a budget and your companions, then fill in each day.
steps.18_map: The footprint map colours every district: visited, recommended, or not yet explored.
steps.19_foryou: For you ranks the districts that fit your DNA and plans, and tells you why. Give a thumbs up or down to tune them.
steps.20_dna: Journey DNA turns your interests and visits into a traveller type, with scores across six categories.
steps.21_gaps: Gap analysis shows what you haven't explored yet, and which provinces to try next.
steps.22_journal_form: Keep a journal. Write about each trip, with dates, a story and photos.
steps.23_journal: All your entries and your travel history live in one tab.
steps.24_stats: And statistics track your districts, provinces and journeys over time.
steps.25_profile: Your profile brings it all together: your DNA, badges, itineraries and downloads.
steps.26_badges: Earn badges as you travel, and take on district challenges.
